question: The election of the Constituent Assembly of India was held in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__July 1946.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first session of constituent assembly was held on December 9, 1946. 
 
• Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the President of the Constituent Assembly on December 11, 1946.
 
• B.R. Ambedkar was appointed as the Chairman of the Drafting Committee, which was formed on August 29, 1947.
 
• The Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on November 26, 1949.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jawaharlal Nehru introduced the **Objective Resolution on December 13, 1946.** 
 
• The Drafting Committee, chaired by **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar**, prepared the draft, which was debated and amended by the Assembly members in several sessions.
 
• The Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **November 26, 1949.**
 
• The Constitution came into effect on **January 26, 1950, **a date chosen to commemorate the declaration of independence of 1930 **(Purna Swaraj).**
